function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies identity using the customer's supplied verification value. This must succeed before any account/debt details can be retrieved.

account_id.description: Customer account identifier. Use ACC-88392 for the demo.

verification_code.description: Customer-provided last four PAN digits or birth year. Never invent this value.

function.name: get_account_details
function.description: Returns debt/account details only when a valid authorization token returned by verify_customer is supplied. Never call before successful verification.

auth_token.description: Short-lived token returned by verify_customer after successful authentication.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Records an explicit customer Promise-to-Pay after authentication.

ptp_date.description: Payment date in ISO-8601 format YYYY-MM-DD.

amount.description: Amount the customer explicitly committed to pay.

auth_token.description: Short-lived authorization token returned by verify_customer.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Triggers a mock payment link to the registered customer channel after a valid PTP or explicit request.

auth_token.description: Short-lived authorization token returned by verify_customer.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Routes cases that need human handling, such as disputes or financial hardship.

auth_token.description: Short-lived authorization token returned by verify_customer.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final outcome of the call. Must be called before ending a normal call.
